certification_notes: 2026-07-17 migrated to registered-face anchored continuous ReID and side-view push-up state machine
description: Lock zhangsan from the shared /home/test/single_function face database, track continuously with adaptive ReID, and count side-view push-ups.
name: push_up

parameters_schema.camera: exercise counting camera; defaults to config.cameras.back.device
parameters_schema.identity_camera: face identity camera; defaults to config.cameras.back.device
parameters_schema.identity_policy: face_and_reid by default; anonymous only when the user explicitly opts out of face recognition and ReID
parameters_schema.name: registered face name; defaults to zhangsan
parameters_schema.projector_after_identity: start the fitness projection only after identity lock
parameters_schema.preparation_delay: seconds reserved for the spoken preparation transition

examples: 本次俯卧撑计数结束，共做了三个。
